description: This file defines the OperatorValidator class within the SuiteCRM API JSON API filters validators namespace. The class implements validation logic for operators used in filters, specifically checking if a given value is a string and valid as per business rules.

classes.name: OperatorValidator
classes.description: Validator class for filter operators, implementing ValidatorInterface, checking if provided operator values are valid strings.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if the provided value is a valid operator string; throws an exception if not.
